messages.text:
"2D top-down retro strategy and building game inspired by classic builder games. The player can place buildings like a lumberjack hut, stone quarry, and storehouse on a grid map. The game features automated resource collection (wood, stone), a simple economy loop, and allows the player to expand their small settlement.
